title: Wan 2.2 Fun Camera
description: Local image-to-video workflow with native preset camera trajectories. A640×640 Pan Right trial produced17 real frames on RTX4090/64GB RAM. Nine native moves are mapped; a five-second Zoom In also passed through the app and SDK. Other hardware and all preset qualities need separate qualification.

evidence: Both pinned diffusion weights were SHA-verified onG: on2026-10-21. Native promptfa500c95-1497-4758-a313-c2ae0cc5f47e succeeded with Pan Right,640x640,17frames,16fps,20steps. Decoded MP4 SHA2560b67b0a9c77da33cfd0f02d090edb3688d6aa9d6fac5da9e5484132588befb3c; actual duration1.0625s. Sampled whole-GPU use reached23288MiB and system free RAM fell to3.24GiB; samples are not a profiler peak or isolated model-memory measurement. App/SDK run c2d6bb80-78c9-46fe-b902-f2bb0b2c0dbe also produced81frames at640x640/16fps,5.0625s, with transportSDK in asset metadata. Other hardware and all movement/speed quality remain unproven.
